_readme: Labeled turns for the classifier eval harness (classify_eval_test.go). Each case is one turn the effort classifier must label. `want` is the reference verdict — the effort levels that give the user the best answer at the lowest cost, per the field semantics: thinking off/low/medium/high (off=no reasoning, high=multi-step); memory none/shallow/deep (none SKIPS both pgvector AND conversation history, so any turn needing prior context must be >=shallow); search none/shallow/deep (none is a HARD veto on web_search — the dangerous one to get wrong on a recency turn). `history` is prior turns for context/pronoun cases. Labels are hand-authored from the system semantics and reviewed against the local 122B; see notes for judgment calls.
